 Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Sanjida Khatoon Wife Of Dilshad D/O-Late Mazar Alam, R/O-Kurisarai  Tola Mirapur, P.S.-BELAGANJ, Distt.-GAYA, Pin-804403  ... ...

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT PATNA
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner : Mr.Prithivi Raj Singh, Adv.
 For the State : Mr.Gauri Shankar Gupta, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 5 07-10-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

Despite valid service of notice, nobody appears on behalf of opposite party no. 2.
2.
The petitioner, husband of the opposite party no. 2, apprehends his arrest in a complaint case punishable for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Allegation against petitioner is of matrimonial cruelty and demand of dowry.
4. While denying the allegations made in the complaint petition, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case merely Patna High Court CR.

MISC.
No.18901 of 2024(5) dt.07-10-2024 because he happens to be husband of opposite party no. 2.
He never demanded any dowry or committed torture with opposite party no. 2 or and is still ready to keep the opposite party no. 2 with full honour and dignity.
Moreover, the case is triable by the learned Magistrate.

The petitioner has further relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in Md. Dilshad @ Md. Dilshad Ansari vs The State Of Bihar on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169292004/
1 2006(3) PLJR 182.
5.

sentences.text:
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, in the event of arrest or surrender within a period of eight weeks from today, let this petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned J.M. 1st Class, Gaya in connection with Complaint Case No. 1162 of 2019,
subject to the conditions, as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J)
anay U T Md. Dilshad
@ Md. Dilshad Ansari vs The State Of Bihar
